verdict.rationale: Word-level timestamps are a fair axis for a speech-to-text API, but nothing in the evidence pack documents per-word start and end times in Deepgram's transcription output. The cited docs cover transcription endpoints, diarization, multichannel, smart formatting and callbacks, none of which establish word-level timing. The community note about a wrong timestamp concerns an old audio search app, not word timestamps in transcripts.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get word-level timestamps so every word maps to its position in the recording
